text.p: Following are the main stories in Tuesday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad yesterday called for a broader use of solar energy which will be an impetus towards the creation of a better quality of life for the rural population of developing countries.

- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said mankind cannot expound the glory of achieving advanced technologies if the innovations are not shared and transferred to those who can use them to narrow the development gap.
- Kedah has proposed that its schoolboys adopt a standard crew cut to enable quick action against them for patronising video arcades or playing truant.
- Ekran Bhd intends to carry out the Infrastructure Project Company flotation of Bakun Hydro-electric Corp on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange in two tranches involving two billion shares each.

- Khazanah Nasional Bhd, the investment arm of the Malaysian government, has announced that it has acquired 15 percent of Malaysia's fast-growing multimedia company, Measat Broadcast Network Systems Sdn Bhd.
